arguments.heading: What happened at the argument
paragraphs: Mr. Geyser argued that ignorance of the law is not an excuse for non-compliance.
Mr. Guarnieri stated the Bank Secrecy Act authorizes a separate penalty for each account.
Mr. Guarnieri claimed the side that brought the case never found a case supporting a single penalty for multiple accounts.

sections.heading: What this case is about
paragraphs: This case tests the scope of civil penalties under the Bank Secrecy Act. the side that brought the case argues the statute limits fines to one per person. The government contends Congress intended a separate fine for every unreported account.
